topic: console market craters as xbox sales crash 33%
headline_marked: [[Console sales crash]] as Xbox sales drop 33%, PS5 sales down 25%
headline: Console sales crash as Xbox sales drop 33%, PS5 sales down 25%
summary: US console sales hit lows not seen in years due to price hikes and inflation. Xbox sales are at an all-time low since its launch.
details: US video game console sales have seen a significant downturn, with PlayStation 5 sales dropping 25% and Xbox sales plummeting 33% year-to-date through August. This marks the lowest point for PS5 sales since 2013 and an all-time low for Xbox since its launch nearly 25 years ago.

Industry analyst Mat Piscatella attributes the decline to price sensitivity among gamers, exacerbated by chip shortages that have forced manufacturers to increase prices. Microsoft has raised Xbox prices multiple times, with 1TB models now costing $150 more.

Sony has also implemented price hikes for the PS5, with the Digital Edition now costing $599.99 and the disc version at $649.99. Even the PS5 Pro and the PlayStation Portal streaming device have seen price increases.

The rising cost of living and console prices have made gaming a lower priority for many families. The market's precarious state is compared to the early 1980s, with hopes pinned on upcoming releases like GTA VI and the holiday season for a potential rebound.

topic: cy berleek threatens gta 6 build leak unless take-two apologizes
headline_marked: [[GTA 6]] full build leak threatened unless memecoin hits $30M
headline: GTA 6 full build leak threatened unless memecoin hits $30M
summary: GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek demands Take-Two apologize and its memecoin reach a $30 million market cap, or a full game build will be released.
details: The notorious leak group Cyberleek has issued an ultimatum to Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games, threatening to release a full build of Grand Theft Auto VI if their demands are not met. These demands include a physical release for the game and a public apology, though the specific reason for the apology remains unclear.

Cyberleek has been leaking segments of GTA 6, seemingly from a near-final build, and has been using these leaks to promote its Solana-based memecoin, $CYBERLEEK. The group reportedly cashed out $250,000 shortly before Rockstar's recent "Extended Look" presentation.

The latest ultimatum, titled "The Offer," shifts the focus to the memecoin's market capitalization. Cyberleek states that the full game build will only be released if the $CYBERLEEK memecoin reaches a market cap of $30 million. Currently, the memecoin's market cap is around $5 million and trending downwards.

Previously, Cyberleek had also linked the release of '4K closeups, fully naked' images of the main character, Lucia, to the memecoin reaching a $6 million market cap. These promised images have yet to materialize, adding to the controversy surrounding the group's actions.

Grand Theft Auto VI is officially scheduled for release on November 19, 2026. Neither Rockstar Games nor Take-Two Interactive have directly commented on Cyberleek's latest ultimatum, though Rockstar previously described the situation as "heartbreaking" for the development team.

Tom's Hardware advises gamers to avoid the low-quality leaks, noting that the leaked footage suffers from poor HDR tonemapping and showcases uninteresting gameplay. The outlet emphasizes waiting for the official release to experience the game as intended.
